title: MZ Help with a NRP and VSMA plugin conflict!!!

posts.author: GreenOx97
posts.body:
Hey
So I've been using two plugins in my MZ project. The first is Enemy Actor by VSMA:
Enemy Actor Plugin
Enemy Actor Version 1.0 VSMA  Feature Have enemies that behave like main characters  How to Use  First, make a new enemy as usual, his sprite is not important, it's will be replaced  by a sv_actor  Then in the parameters of the plug-in: - open the parameter enemy actors - add a new element and...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
Which basically replaces enemies with SV actor sprites. Great  and simple plugin, one of the first ones I got.
The second is NRP's Learn Skill plugin:
リスト形式のスキル習得システム【RPGツクールMZプラグイン】 - New RPG Project
Which adds a Learn Skill list to your game. The actors gain Skill Points from defeating enemies and leveling up, and can spend them to learn skills. This one was more complex, but I've started to get the hang of it.
The trouble is that NRP's plugin is now coming up with an error code which I've determined only comes up if there are enemies that are using VSMA's plugin.
When a battle finishes, this error comes up:
Through testing, I've discovered the following:
1. The error only occurs when the Switch that determines whether actors can currently gain SP from defeating individual enemies is turned on.
2. It doesn't occur if the battle just has static enemies, only if there are sv animated enemies in the troop.
3. Actors can still can SP from leveling up without issue.
From that, I tentatively concluded that something in VSMA's is conflicting with the part of NRP's that determines how much SP is gained from individual enemies. But I don't have any idea how to fix it.
Can anyone help me with this? I really don't want to lose either plugin.
If it helps, I also have this error log. I only just discovered this feature today, so I don't if there's anything else that I need to show or not:
